answer: A Sybil defence in an agent economy is stake-backed certification: to act, an agent posts a bond peers can slash after misbehaviour, so a fake swarm needs real capital per identity. Attestations build a ledge of signed claims, each locking a deposit, so forging thousands of agents means funding thousands of bonds. A dispute touching one slashed bond sends a ripple through the cluster and freezes it whole. Reputation is a prism, splitting conduct into facets bound to the bond, not the name, so a clone cannot borrow history. The bill grows linearly as payout stays flat, killing the swarm edge.
